title: Jacy Jayne Defended After Injuring Brie Bella At WWE SummerSlam 2026 - NewsBreak
text:
By Ryan Clark ,
52 minutes ago
Stevie Richards does not believe Jacy Jayne should be blamed for the injury Brie Bella suffered at WWE SummerSlam 2026.
Bella sustained a broken scapula during the six-woman tag team match that saw The Bella Twins and Paige face Fatal Influence. The injury reportedly happened when Jayne hit a cannonball onto the steel ring steps at ringside. Despite the injury, the bout continued, with Paige eventually taking the pinfall before The Bella Twins attacked her after the match.
Following SummerSlam 2026, Brie was taken to a local hospital and was forced to miss her scheduled fan meet-and-greet. She later confirmed that she had fractured her scapula and revealed that the match nearly came to an early end because of the severity of the injury.

Discussing the incident on his “The Stevie Richards Show,” the former WWE Hardcore Champion defended Jayne, saying the move itself was executed properly and that he saw nothing wrong with her technique. He said,
“There was no what went wrong with the way the girl delivered the cannonball. There was nothing wrong with that. I just feel like Brie tried to do… maybe she was protecting her head from hitting the steps. I don’t know, but it’s an honest mistake.”
“I would really stress to be body to body in the center right here and not side to side. You might get squished a little bit. You might get the wind knocked out of you, but you’re not going to break any bones like that doing it on the stairs.”
“It introduces a level of rigidity. It’s too rigid to where you can’t bounce off. Most people do the cannonball, they hit it and then they kind of bounce back to where they roll backwards. You don’t get that because there’s no bounce to this. That’s a hard thing to take.”
“It’s an honest mistake. Brie didn’t do anything wrong. I think she just tried to… and for all we know, did she take a headshot before this or anything to get into this position? She could be selling the back of her head off of that.”
